sources.title: JJarvinen/chatterbox-finnish-nano - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Finnish language adaptation of Chatterbox Nano for conversational TTS. It supports both reference-free Finnish speech using the retained built-in Nano conditioning and optional reference-voice conditioning.

sources.title: Chatterbox Finnish Nano - a Hugging Face Space by JJarvinen
sources.snippet: This app turns up to 600 characters of Finnish text into spoken audio. You can also upload a short reference recording to make the synthetic voice sound similar to that speaker.
